vo.text: Noise-cancelling headphones do not just block sound.
vo.speak: Noise-cancelling headphones do not just block sound.

vo.text: They erase part of it by adding more sound.
vo.speak: They erase part of it by adding more sound.

vo.text: Sound travels through air as pressure waves, with peaks and troughs.
vo.speak: Sound travels through air as pressure waves, with peaks and troughs.

vo.text: A tiny microphone on the outside listens to the noise around you.
vo.speak: A tiny microphone on the outside listens to the noise around you.

vo.text: Inside, the electronics create a copy of that noise.
vo.speak: Inside, the electronics create a copy of that noise.

vo.text: But the copy is flipped: every peak becomes a trough.
vo.speak: But the copy is flipped: every peak becomes a trough.

vo.text: The speaker plays this anti-noise at exactly the right moment.
vo.speak: The speaker plays this anti-noise at exactly the right moment.

vo.text: When both waves reach your ear, their opposing pressures largely cancel.
vo.speak: When both waves reach your ear, their opposing pressures largely cancel.

vo.text: It works best on steady, low sounds, like an engine's hum.
vo.speak: It works best on steady, low sounds, like an engine's hum.

vo.text: Sudden sounds are harder to predict, so some noise still gets through.
vo.speak: Sudden sounds are harder to predict, so some noise still gets through.

vo.text: So silence is not always less sound. Sometimes, it is a carefully timed copy, played in reverse.
vo.speak: So silence is not always less sound. Sometimes, it is a carefully timed copy, played in reverse.
